command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'flyexplorer_large_icons_gui.py'; @'

import base64, ctypes as c, hashlib, io, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from pywinauto import Desktop
import psutil

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
assert EXE.is_file(), EXE

base=ROOT/"logs"/"large-icons-owned"
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for old in base.glob("large-icons-*"):
    try:
        shutil.rmtree(old)
    except Exception:
        pass

legacy=("fxfile.conf","fxfile-main.conf","fxfile-toolbar.dat",
        "fxfile-coolbar.dat","fxfile-dlg_state.conf","fxfile-folder_layout.conf")
real=Path(os.environ["APPDATA"])/"fxfile"/"conf"
before={n:hashlib.sha256((real/n).read_bytes()).digest()
        for n in legacy if (real/n).is_file()}

owned=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="large-icons-",dir=base))
folder=owned/"fixture"
folder.mkdir()
for i in range(1,13):
    (folder/f"Benchmark item {i:02d}.txt").write_text(
        f"owned benchmark {i}\n",encoding="utf-8")
for i in range(1,5):
    img=Image.new("RGB",(320,200),(40*i,36*i,28*i))
    ImageDraw.Draw(img).rectangle((160,0,319,199),fill=(24*i,70,145))
    img.save(folder/f"Sample image {i:02d}.png")

env=os.environ.copy()
for key in ("APPDATA","LOCALAPPDATA","TEMP","TMP"):
    target=owned/key.lower()
    target.mkdir()
    env[key]=str(target)
pref=Path(env["LOCALAPPDATA"])/"flyExplorer"
pref.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(pref/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
    "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
    encoding="ascii",newline="")
for key in ("FLY_M23_OWNED_DRAG_TEST","FLY_M23_OWNED_SESSION","FLY_M23_OWNED_DRAG_TRACE"):
    env.pop(key,None)

process=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(folder)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
hwnd=None
passed=False
try:
    deadline=time.time()+25
    while time.time()<deadline:
        if process.poll() is not None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"flyExplorer exited early: {process.returncode}")
        matches=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=process.pid)
                 if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        if len(matches)==1:
            hwnd=matches[0].handle
            break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if hwnd is None:
        raise RuntimeError("owned flyExplorer window not found")

    win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd)
    wrapper=win.wrapper_object()
    wrapper.set_focus()
    try:
        wrapper.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception:
        pass
    time.sleep(2.0)

    pane=win.child_window(auto_id="LeftFiles")
    if not pane.exists(timeout=5):
        raise AssertionError("LeftFiles UIA surface missing")
    deadline=time.time()+18
    rows=[]
    while time.time()<deadline:
        rows=[item for item in pane.descendants()
              if item.element_info.control_type=="ListItem" and item.window_text()]
        if len(rows)>=12:
            break
        time.sleep(.3)

    print("FLY_LARGE_ITEM_COUNT",len(rows),flush=True)
    rects=[]
    for row in rows[:8]:
        r=row.rectangle()
        item=(row.window_text(),r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height())
        rects.append(item)
        print("FLY_LARGE_ITEM_RECT",repr(item),flush=True)
    if len(rows)<8:
        raise AssertionError("Large Icons did not render enough owned items")

    image_rects=[]
    for row in rows:
        for child in row.descendants(control_type="Image"):
            try:
                if "Windows Shell image thumbnail" in child.element_info.name:
                    r=child.rectangle()
                    image_rects.append((r.width(),r.height()))
            except Exception:
                pass
    print("FLY_LARGE_THUMBNAIL_RECTS",repr(image_rects[:4]),flush=True)

    img=wrapper.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
    img.thumbnail((486,360))
    buf=io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf,format="JPEG",quality=80,optimize=True)
    print("FLY_LARGE_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True)
    print(base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii"),flush=True)
    print("FLY_LARGE_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)

    widths=[r[3] for r in rects]
    heights=[r[4] for r in rects]
    if not all(100<=w<=125 for w in widths):
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected Large Icons widths: {widths}")
    if not all(118<=h<=134 for h in heights):
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected Large Icons heights: {heights}")
    if image_rects and not all(54<=w<=70 and 54<=h<=70 for w,h in image_rects[:4]):
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected thumbnail sizes: {image_rects[:4]}")
    passed=True
finally:
    if process.poll() is None:
        if hwnd:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(hwnd,0x10,0,0)
            try: process.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.terminate();process.wait(timeout=8)
        else:
            process.terminate();process.wait(timeout=8)
    unchanged=all((real/n).is_file() and hashlib.sha256((real/n).read_bytes()).digest()==h
                  for n,h in before.items())
    print("ORIGINAL_SIX_USER_CONFIG_SHA256_IDENTICAL",unchanged,flush=True)
    print("OWNED_LARGE_ICONS_PROCESS_EXIT",process.returncode,flush=True)
    if passed and unchanged and process.returncode==0:
        shutil.rmtree(owned)
    else:
        print("OWNED_LARGE_ICONS_FIXTURE_RETAINED",owned,flush=True)
if not passed or not unchanged or process.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("LARGE_ICONS_OWNED_GUI_PASS",flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
